newsitem.title: UK: British jobless rate falls to 5.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: British jobless rate falls to 5.7 pct.

text.p: Britain's jobless rate fell to 5.7 percent in June, the government said on Wednesday in the latest indicator of strong economic growth.
May's jobless rate was 5.8 percent. The Office for National Statistics said the number of unemployed dropped 36,500 in June, continuing a steady pickup in the nation's employment picture.
Economists had expected a drop in June's unemployment rate, following a year-long trend in which the labour market has tightened and the economy gathered steam.
The June drop reduced the jobless rate to its lowest level in more than seven years.
It was the 16th consecutive fall in the seasonally adjusted total, which is now at its lowest level since April 1990.
The latest data helped fuel speculation that British interest rates must rise again to put a cap on economic growth and keep inflation in check.
